response.evidence: About 20 applications in this dataset are from Black or African American male applicants, and all of them were originated (0 denials). These approvals span ages 25-74, DTI from 20% to 49%, and LTV up to 100%. Across all Black or African American applicants (male, female, and joint), there are only about 5 denials, a rate similar to or below the dataset-wide denial rate of roughly 8-10%. Denials across all racial groups cluster around high DTI (50%-60% and >60%) and high LTV (95-100%), which suggests financial factors rather than race drive outcomes. Limitations: the sample of Black applicants is small, the data lacks credit scores and lender-stated denial reasons, and aggregate patterns cannot prove or rule out discrimination in any single application, including yours.
